heading: What Our Patients Say About Dentiq Dentistry

items.quote: My husband Sam and I are both new patients at this practice and we are both so happy with the care that we have received. Our hygienist, Mandy is the absolute best! My husband was very nervous and had a lot of anxiety because it had been so long since he had seen a dentist. Mandy was able to ease his fears and she made him feel very comfortable; he now looks forward to his future visits and additional dental work. The practice is very clean and the atmosphere is very welcoming. The office staff and the doctors are great as well. We highly recommend this practice to anyone in search of dental care.
items.author: Natalie Davis

items.quote: Dentiq is a unique place. My wife and I love the entire staff. Today in particular we love how Mandy and Janet assisted us. Everyone in this office is caring, friendly and professional. I am happy with this dentistry and as such recommend it to anyone looking for a great dentist.
items.author: Chinedu Ezea

items.quote: I absolutely love Dentiq!! Honestly I was never a fan of going to the dentist, but the staff at Dentiq are sooo kind, and I actually look forward to my appointments. You're greeted with beautiful smiles, happy energy, and a cozy atmosphere. Everyone there shares in your excitement regardless of where you're at in your teeth journey. Even calling them up to reschedule an appointment feels like a phone call with a friend 🙂 Thank you, Dentiq!
items.author: Natalie Romano
